name: Copilot Money OG social card by copilot.money
description: A 1200×630 social card built almost entirely on scale contrast: a three-line display headline in pale ice-blue dominates the left 55% of the canvas, set at roughly 120px with very tight leading, while a small logo lockup sits top-left and a one-line platform note anchors the bottom-left on the same margin. The right 45% is a diagonal cluster of iPhone, iPad and MacBook mockups, each rotated a few degrees and bleeding off the right and bottom edges, their dark-mode app screens (line charts, budget rings) providing the only saturated accents. Depth comes from a navy radial gradient plus soft shadows under the devices — no borders, cards or dividers anywhere.
